observes: AUDITIB ledger lifecycle. enable(strict=True,max_ops=7,recon_bound=11) on an enabled ledger ignores every argument; disable();enable() resets strict to False; set_strict(True) on a disabled ledger is accepted and lost on re-enable; re-enable keeps max_ops=50000/recon_bound=250000 from genesis and sets strict only from its argument. Predictions from Ledger.cls:252-380 confirmed; no stated contract violated (ledger-api.md:22-24 is silent on settings; LedgerNotEnabledError means never-enabled, errors.py:18-19).
